title: Unify Board Element Styling States
description: Make board styling consistent across node, edge, handle, and wire. Extend element style support to cover original, neutral, hovered, selected, highlighted, disabled. Add a shared style prop through the board element contract and use it consistently across features. Add a window option for original style, default false, so imported elements such as SVGs can remain unmodified when requested. Validate through focused tests/builds.
summary: Finished the remaining selected/preselected parity cleanup in the Rust board renderer. Selected and preselected states now keep the same selected chrome even through visible-element override paths: link-compatible node highlighting no longer overrides selected nodes, and indirect handle rings keep their indirect neutral appearance only for neutral/original handles while selected or preselected handles use the shared selected style. Validation: cargo test -p elements_board --lib passed; bun nx run @elements/board:test passed Rust tests, wasm-pack, and Vitest. Playwright still reproduces the same two existing failures in the board play background context menu and redraw toolbar tests.
